description: This file defines a class JsonSerializerDocumentifier that creates a document representation from a SugarBean object using BeanJsonSerializer. It provides a human-friendly document for advanced search queries, bypassing search definition files.

classes.name: JsonSerializerDocumentifier
classes.description: A class that creates a document from a SugarBean using BeanJsonSerializer, for human-friendly search purposes. It does not use search definitions and is not module-customisable.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the JsonSerializerDocumentifier with a BeanJsonSerializer instance.

methods.name: documentify
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean into a serialized array, applies fixes for phone and email fields, removes 'id', and returns the resulting document data.
